description: ActionMode, SendingMode, DispositionType are Serialize+Deserialize but have no Display. Any code (including MemoryBackend send_mdns) that needs the wire string must do serde_json::to_value(mode).ok().and_then(|v| v.as_str().map(String::from)).unwrap_or_else(|| ...). This is an indirect, error-prone pattern contributors will copy. Without Display, there is no way to convert to wire string without a serde call or match arms. Adding Display to each enum (matching the serde wire values) is a backwards-compatible addition that should happen now before the crate is published.
title: ActionMode/SendingMode/DispositionType have no Display impl — forces serde round-trip for string conversion
